name: thunderpan-sync
description: Watch local folders and back them up to Xunlei Cloud Drive automatically
author: ThunderPanSync contributors
dependencies_note: - CDP 客户端（engine/cdp.js）用 Node 内置 WebSocket + http，不用 playwright
- 界面是 C# WinForms 原生控件，不用 Electron
runtime/node.exe 打包时从本机 Node 复制，随包分发（MIT，见 THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md）
